missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Океан' is a hard-stem masculine noun in the nominative as the subject. 'Спокойный' is the agreeing masculine adjective describing its state.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Океан' is the accusative direct object of 'любим'. As an inanimate masculine noun, the accusative matches the nominative. 'Тёплый' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Океана' is genitive, showing whose depth it is, the depth of the ocean. The hard-stem masculine genitive ending is -а. A property-of-something pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Океану' is the dative singular after 'к', marking the goal of motion. The hard-stem masculine dative ending is -у. A natural movement-toward phrase.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Океаном' is instrumental after 'любуемся', the thing admired. The hard-stem instrumental ending is -ом, and 'бескрайним' agrees. A common admiration verb.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Океане' is prepositional after 'в', marking location inside the ocean. The hard-stem prepositional ending is -е. A core spatial pattern.
Strategic focus: Prepositional with 'об'. 'Океане' is prepositional after 'об', the object of dreaming. 'Долго' adds duration. A typical pattern for thinking and dreaming about something.
Strategic focus: Genitive after numeral. 'Океана' is the genitive singular required after the numeral 'четыре'. Numbers two through four take the genitive singular. A key numeral-agreement pattern.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Океаны' is the nominative plural, the subject of the sentence. The hard-stem plural ending is -ы, and 'все' agrees in the plural. Shows plural formation.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Океанов' is the genitive plural after 'глубины', the depths of the oceans. The hard-stem genitive plural ending is -ов. A useful quantity-of pattern.
